Badger Meter - Where Every Drop Counts and So Do You 
 
 At Badger Meter, we're more than a leading global water technology company - we're innovators with a mission: to preserve and protect the world's most precious resource. For over 120 years, our trusted solutions have enabled our customers to optimize the delivery and use of water, maximize revenue and reduce waste. 
 
 Every employee at Badger Meter is an important part of our success. Here, your work doesn't just move a business forward - it shapes a more sustainable future. We are committed to building a workplace where we celebrate differences, empower voices, and encourage fresh ideas that drive innovation. 
 
 When you join us, you'll find:
 
• Purpose-driven work that makes a real difference in communities around the globe.
 
• Career growth and development opportunities designed to help you achieve your potential.
 
• A supportive, inclusive culture where collaboration and creativity thrive. 
 
 Be part of something bigger. At Badger Meter, your contributions will ripple far beyond the workplace - creating lasting change for people and the planet.
 
 What You Will Contribute: 

 The Badger Meter Internship Program provides hands-on, real-world experience to students through projects that make a difference! In addition to your projects, you will be given the opportunity to participate in our robust Intern program focused on Badger Meter Culture, professional development, community outreach, and a final capstone project.
  
 Badger Meter is hiring a Software Engineering Intern for our SmartCover Software Engineering team. The Software Engineering Intern will be responsible for software development & implementation of test applications, coding, and debugging new software or making enhancements to existing software.
  
 This will be an onsite internship at our office in either Melbourne, Florida or Escondido, California next summer (40 hours a week).
  
 What You Will Gain: 
 
• Experience developing and maintaining production software 
• Hands-on experience with Python, PHP, JavaScript, MySQL, Docker, Git, and APIs 
• Exposure to software design, testing, debugging, and deployment 
• Experience with source control, code reviews, and technical documentation 
• Opportunities to solve real-world software engineering challenges 
• Collaboration experience with engineers and cross-functional teams 
• Growth in technical communication and problem-solving skills 
• Insight into professional software development best practices  
 Essential Job Duties: 
 
• Support the SmartCover software engineering team through assigned software development projects 
• Develop and enhance web applications, APIs, and integrated platform features 
• Create and execute automated tests to support software quality and reliability 
• Develop internal tools and process automation solutions to improve team efficiency 
• Assist with database development, maintenance, and optimization 
• Prepare and maintain technical documentation for applications and development processes 
• Contribute to software integration and platform development efforts 
• Collaborate with software engineers to deliver solutions that support customer and internal business needs 
• Gain hands-on experience with production software, development best practices, and modern engineering tools 
• Participate in projects based on team priorities and individual skills and interests  
 Qualifications: 
 
• Pursuing a degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field 
• Experience with programming and web development using Python, PHP, and JavaScript 
• Familiarity with MySQL databases and development tools such as Docker and Git 
• General understanding of web applications, APIs, software testing, and troubleshooting 
• Strong problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills 
• Eagerness to learn and adapt to new technologies 
• Preferred: Experience with embedded firmware development and debugging processes  
 This internship provides meaningful, project-based work with defined deliverables, hands-on learning opportunities, and ongoing coaching and mentorship.
  
 An Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. This company considers candidates regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status. Applicants can learn more about their rights regarding equal opportunity in employment by viewing the federal "EEO is the Law" poster and the “EEO is the Law” poster supplement at http://www.dol.gov/ofccp/regs/compliance/posters/ofccpost.htm 
 
 Badger Meter complies with all aspects of the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), as amended by the ADA Amendments Act, and all applicable state or local disability laws. This means that we will reasonably accommodate qualified employees with a disability if accommodation would allow them to perform the essential functions of their job, unless doing so would create an undue hardship.   
 
 Privacy Statement 
 The Employee and Applicant Privacy Statement describes how we collect, use, share, retain, and safeguard applicant information.  Please see the privacy statement on our website here .
fit_why: Python, JS, SQL, Docker, Git, APIs match; MySQL/PHP and firmware preferred

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, test, and deploy software solutions using a variety of programming languages and technologies 

• Implement and maintain both frontend and backend components of our applications 

• Develop and optimize algorithms to solve complex problems 

• Engineer low-latency solutions to proprietary computational operations 

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand and define software requirements

Qualifications:
• Must be pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related quantitative field from an accredited 4-year university 

• Proficiency in Python and C++ 

• Familiarity with embedded and real-time systems programming 

• Knowledge of software architecture and design paradigms 

• Strong communication and teamwork skills 

• Willingness to take ownership of projects and work autonomously

Bonus Qualifications:
• A strong portfolio of personal software or hardware-related projects 

• Familiarity with the CUDA toolkit and associated programming practices 

• Familiarity with GPU-accelerated libraries such as PyTorch and OpenGL/ThreeJS
